cqs.name: Likelihood Question
cqs.question: How likely is it that doing ‘tax meat’ would actually lead to ‘lower emissions’?

cqs.name: Evidence Question
cqs.question: What evidence shows that doing ‘tax meat’ would lead to ‘lower emissions’, and is it strong enough for the confidence with which the claim is made?

cqs.name: Outweighing Harm Question
cqs.question: Would doing ‘tax meat’ have bad consequences that matter more than ‘lower emissions’?

cqs.name: Slight Consequence Question
cqs.question: Granted that doing ‘tax meat’ would or could bring about ‘lower emissions’, is ‘lower emissions’ too slight a consequence to count in deciding on ‘tax meat’? (Reaching few does not make a consequence slight: one weighty gain or harm can decide.).

cqs.name: Discounted Gain Question
cqs.question: Who would gain ‘lower emissions’, and does that make it count for less in deciding on ‘tax meat’?

cqs.name: Side Effects Question
cqs.question: Would doing ‘tax meat’ also bring about something bad?

cqs.name: Challenge
cqs.question: Why should we accept this premise?

premise_texts: ‘An agency economist’ is an expert in ‘emissions’.
“‘An agency economist’ says that C”, and this is based on evidence.
exception_texts: ‘An agency economist’ is not a trustworthy source.

cqs.name: Expertise Question
cqs.question: Does ‘an agency economist’ really have the knowledge of ‘emissions’, and the standing in it, that the argument credits ‘an agency economist’ with?

cqs.name: Field Question
cqs.question: Is “doing ‘tax meat’ brings about ‘lower emissions’” a matter that ‘emissions’, the domain in which ‘an agency economist’ is cited, actually covers?

cqs.name: Opinion Question
cqs.question: Did ‘an agency economist’ in fact put “doing ‘tax meat’ brings about ‘lower emissions’” forward as true, in words that amount to “doing ‘tax meat’ brings about ‘lower emissions’” or imply it?

cqs.name: Trustworthiness Question
cqs.question: Is there reason to doubt ‘an agency economist’'s personal reliability as a source, such as bias, dishonesty or carelessness?

cqs.name: Consistency Question
cqs.question: Does what other experts in ‘emissions’ say conflict with “doing ‘tax meat’ brings about ‘lower emissions’”?

cqs.name: Backup Evidence Question
cqs.question: Has ‘an agency economist’ any data, study or observation behind the claim that “doing ‘tax meat’ brings about ‘lower emissions’”, or is it an unsupported view?
